items.headline: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Microsoft on Wednesday disclosed that a China state-aligned actor dubbed Storm-0940 was behind the recent supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application. During the incident, Storm-0940 used ARTEX, a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework that was made closed-source in the wake of its abuse in cyber attacks targeting South Korean financial institutions, to speed.

items.headline: Exposed Infrastructure Reveals How Ransomware Affiliates Used AI Agents to Execute Intrusions
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven intrusion ecosystem run by affiliates of the INC and The Gentlemen ransomware groups. Central to the operation is an "Autonomous Red Team Kill Chain Framework" referred to as Phantom.
